plot_image_grid_rgb: plot a grid of RGBA images showing only RGB channels using image_grid
plot_image_grid_alpha: plot a grid of images showing only the alpha channel using image_grid with rgb=False
plot_image_grid_custom_layout: plot images in a custom row and column grid layout using image_grid with rows and cols
plot_image_grid_fill: plot a tightly packed image grid with no spacing using image_grid with fill=True
plot_image_grid_with_axes: plot an image grid with visible axes using image_grid with show_axes=True
